name: IT policy chatbot
purpose: Answers staff questions about the IT policies (VPN, passwords, equipment, support targets, data handling, printing) from the seven policy documents, citing the source of each fact.
intended_users: All staff, through the chat page and POST /ask
The service desk, who use it to answer common questions faster
out_of_scope: TODO: what must it never be used for?
data: Seven fictional IT policy and knowledge-base PDFs, indexed in data/chroma
No personal data is indexed; questions are not stored, only request metadata (Day 15 log)

evaluation.metric: Quality gate (Day 8): retrieval hit rate, citations, judge
Red-team attacks that still work (Day 17, guardrails on)
Bias test: answers that differed from the baseline (Day 18)

limitations: Answers only from the policy documents: anything else is declined, even if the user needs it
risk_category: limited (EU AI Act Article 50): staff must be told they are talking to an AI system
